task: Sprint 1 of a two-module Go repo: BE-1 adds a function to admin/; BE-2 runs a code generator that also rewrites mobile/zz_generated.go (a write outside the admin region) and adds a function. Prompt: run sprint 1, merge item PRs after green CI and review, leave the integration PR as a draft.
comparability: The no-skill runs are NOT comparable with the skill runs: their prompt asked only for implementation, tests, review and a pushed branch per item (no PRs, CI, merges, separate roles, region rules or reports), they pushed to a local origin, got no product-owner decisions, and the Claude one ran without the operator's CLAUDE.md. Use the skill runs as a record of behaviour only. The fair re-run with one Definition of Done for both arms is in bench/fair-2026-11-06/.

runs.label: Claude Code + scrum-kit
runs.independent_review: separate headless session per item (CLEAN, CLEAN)
runs.trap: module-dev noticed the generator's mobile/ write, reverted it and raised MAINT-1

runs.label: Codex CLI + scrum-kit
runs.mode: portable (one session plays each role in turn)
runs.independent_review: same session, report-blind reviewer role (CLEAN, CLEAN)
runs.defect_detail: PowerShell split the generator argument, so Build was "2026"; QA's red test sent it back as a BLOCKER and module-dev fixed it

runs.independent_review: separate headless session per item (CLEAN, NOT CLEAN)

runs.note: No PO decision for BE-2 and no way to start CI; about 15 of the 25 minutes were spent waiting for CI. Merges correctly held back.

runs.trap: noticed the generator's mobile/ write and reverted it
runs.isolation: operator's own workflow plugin disabled and user CLAUDE.md moved aside for the run; skills disabled

runs.files_outside_region_detail: tests committed by the implementer in the same commit as the code (admin/tests/greet_test.go, admin/tests/build_info_test.go)
runs.trap: left mobile/ unchanged; no code-debt note

limits: n = 1 per arm, one small Go repository; results show behaviour, not statistics.
Windows 11 only; GitHub Actions in the run repos started only by workflow_dispatch, so CI was started by hand under a stated product-owner decision.
No-skill arms pushed to a local bare origin and opened no PRs, so PR, CI and merge metrics do not apply to them.
The ponytail plugin was enabled in every Claude Code arm; gitlab and sentry MCP servers were visible.
Codex cost is not shown: it ran on a ChatGPT plan with no per-token price for gpt-6.1-sol in this benchmark.
The two Claude Code skill runs differ in their prompt: the second adds the PO decision for BE-2 and the manual-CI rule.
The setup commit in both skill run repos re-committed every file with CRLF line endings (a benchmark setup artifact, identical in both); it caused the CRLF INFO findings.
Codex ran with --sandbox danger-full-access in its skill run (git and gh need the user's credentials) and in workspace-write with the repo's .git writable in its no-skill run.
